source.note: Bank's own internships page, which carries an explicit 'Eligibility' paragraph.

class_year.quote: To apply for an internship, you must be a full-time undergraduate, graduate, or Ph.D. student enrolled in an accredited four-year college or university.

compensation.quote: We offer a variety of paid internships across different business areas, including economic research, bank supervision, community development, and technology, to name a few.

cooling_off.notes: The page carries no sentence addressing reapplication, waiting periods, or a cap on applications. Searched the fetched markup for 'reappl', 're-appl' and 'apply again': no match.

unfiled_quotes.quote: There may be opportunities for interns to continue to work part-time after the internship ends, or to start an internship at a different time throughout the year, depending on departmental needs.

provenance.note: Sponsorship is silent: the page contains no occurrence of citizen, visa, CPT, OPT, sponsor or work authorisation. That silence is worth noting rather than assuming, because the Federal Reserve Board states a flat citizenship bar and the Atlanta Fed states a CPT position, while this body publishes neither. Silent here means only that nothing is published on the point.
